broadcast_all_local_devices: broadcast a pytree to all local JAX devices with optional axis name sharding
replicate_all_local_devices: replicate a pytree across all local JAX devices with optional named sharding axis
distribute_thunks: distribute thunk computations over pmapped devices in round-robin fashion and gather results
host_all_gather: gather pytree values across all hosts using pmap-based host synchronization
make_different_rng_key_on_all_devices: generate a different PRNG key on each JAX device and process for parallel random number generation
